Status as of **2026-08-31**. This tracks the path from a two-person TestFlight
beta to something a stranger can install. Update the status column as things
move; do not delete rows, so the history of what was decided stays readable.

**Legend** — ✅ done and verified · 🟡 done but unverified · ⬜ not started ·
❓ unknown, needs a look · 🚫 blocked on a decision

---

## The decision everything else hangs on

**How are we distributing?** Still open, and it changes which rows below matter.

| Option | Cap | Review | Longevity |
|---|---|---|---|
| TestFlight external | 10,000 testers | Beta App Review | Builds expire every 90 days |
| Unlisted App Distribution | none | Full App Store review | Permanent, no discovery |
| Public listing | none | Full App Store review | Permanent |

If we stay on TestFlight, most of *Store listing* below is not required yet.
Everything in *Apple hard requirements* and *Our own bar* applies either way.

You cannot cap downloads on a normal listing. Any "limited release" has to come
from TestFlight's own cap or from being unlisted.

---

## Apple hard requirements

These are rejections, not preferences.

| Item | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| In-app account deletion (5.1.1(v)) | 🟡 | Built 2026-08-31. Settings → Danger Zone. **Not yet exercised against the deployed stack.** |
| Account deletion documented publicly | 🟡 | `website/account-deletion.md` drafted, not hosted |
| Privacy policy URL | 🟡 | `website/privacy-policy.md` drafted, not hosted, has placeholders |
| Privacy nutrition labels | ⬜ | Must declare email, audio, photos, and the Anthropic/OpenAI processing. Wrong answers here are a rejection |
| Demo account for review (2.1) | ⬜ | Reviewers need a working account **and** a household with data in it. A fresh account sees an empty app |
| Age rating questionnaire | ⬜ | |
| Export compliance declaration | ❓ | HTTPS-only usually qualifies for the exemption; needs confirming, not assuming |
| Support URL | ⬜ | `website/support.md` drafted, not hosted |

---

## Our own bar before strangers get in

Not Apple's rules — ours. See `world-release-blockers` in session memory.

| Item | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Per-household authorization | ✅ | Verified 2026-08-30 with a real outsider account: reads and writes both denied |
| Invite codes single-use, 30 min | ✅ | Verified against production |
| Household required for every AI call | ✅ | Reject and allow paths both verified |
| AppSync request logging | ✅ | ERROR level, bodies excluded, 14-day retention; verified by generating denials |
| S3 enumeration closed | ✅ | `list` withheld; deployed policy confirmed |
| S3 per-household scoping | ⬜ | Anyone holding a key can still read or delete that file. Lambda broker is the fix, ~a day. See `s3-scoping-plan` |
| `joinHousehold` rate limiting | 🚫 | Deliberately deferred. Needs a decision: lock after N failures, throttle, or both |
| Password floor above 6 chars | ⬜ | Cognito is at its own minimum with no complexity rules |
| Signup gating | ⬜ | Much less urgent now — a junk account costs a Cognito row and nothing else |

## Legal

| Item | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Trademark clearance | ✅ | Renamed off `NotOurGroceries`; OURGROCERIES is a live mark covering the same goods |
| CCPA / CPRA | ❓ | Almost certainly below all three thresholds — revenue, 100k California consumers, 50% of revenue from selling data. Revisit before wide release. Not a lawyer |
| GDPR | ❓ | Plausible the moment there is one EU or UK user. No compliance claim written either way |
| Legal entity | ⬜ | Individual or company; drives the seller name and the liability wording |

## Release mechanics

| Item | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/release.sh` | ✅ | Tags `vX.Y.Z`, bumps `main` to the next minor |
| TestFlight CI on tag push | ✅ | `.github/workflows/testflight.yml`, stamps a datetime build number |
| 90-day expiry job | ✅ | Scheduled rebuild so TestFlight builds do not lapse |
| CHANGELOG up to date | ⬜ | `[Unreleased]` empty with 27 commits since v1.6.0 |
| TestFlight build current | ⬜ | Stale at v1.6.0, several schema changes behind and broken against the current backend |

## What is deliberately not being built

- **Monetization.** Direction agreed — no feature gating, volume metered on
  trips, roughly \$0.99 to finish the month. Blocked on cost-per-household, which
  needs the Anthropic and OpenAI usage figures. AWS is \$3.19/month for the whole
  account, so those two numbers are the entire equation.
- **Ads.** Rejected. Sessions are seconds long and it is a shared family utility.
